summary: Zane Mason, 33, Crested Butte native, died in a fall while snowskating outside the Crested Butte Mountain Resort boundary on the west side of the Butte; a paraglider spotted his body at the base of a 250-ft cliff in the Terminator Chutes and authorities were notified 3:05 p.m. Monday; a resort Hasty Team confirmed the fatality and CBSAR completed the recovery the next morning, carrying him to the McCormick Ranch area by 9 a.m.
location: Terminator Chutes, west side of Mt Crested Butte
notes: Incident date 2015-03-16 (Monday); recovery by CBSAR on the morning of 2015-03-17 after a standby hold Monday due to unstable conditions and fading light. Coroner: no autopsy; Gunnison County Sheriff investigation. Date weekday-verified (2015-03-16 = Monday).
